meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可执行联网搜索与网页内容抓取，按科学/技术查询优先学术来源，引用时附作者、年份或 DOI。
howto.when: 当你说要搜索、查资料、抓取某个网址内容（网页、文章、PDF）时触发。

say.text: 搜索最新量子计算论文
say.note: 会启动 Web Search，并偏向学术来源。

say.text: 抓取并总结这个网页的内容：https://example.com
say.note: 用 Web Extract 获取该网址正文。

say.text: 查 3D 打印材料的学术资料
say.note: 会自动加 research paper 分类过滤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run Exa-powered web searches and URL extraction, targeted at scientific/technical content. For scholarly queries it can bias toward research papers and academic domains, and cite authors, year, and DOI links when available.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to search, look up a topic, fetch a URL (webpage, article, PDF), or extract an article. Also suitable for research requests wanting scholarly bias.

say_en.text: Search for the latest papers on quantum computing
say_en.note: Routes to Web Search with an academic bias.

say_en.text: Fetch and summarize this article for me: [URL]
say_en.note: Uses Web Extract to read the page contents.

say_en.text: Find research papers about 3D printing materials
